# CN04 package brief

Version: 1.1
Status: evidence-mapped production artifact

## Purpose
Produce a seven-day living-archive sprint while the founder can narrate decisions.

## Governing question
Why begin preservation before estate administration?

## Evidence spine
S08; S39; S40; S41

## Claim or field architecture
Files need context; preservation requires inventory, description and planned storage

## Production outputs
3000-word guide; seven emails; audio prompts; pairing tool; before/after map

## Release gate
Not estate, conservation or legal advice; private user data stays local.

## Accessibility and rights
Captions, transcripts, keyboard behavior, visible labels, exact canonical records, and object-level implementation decisions are mandatory.
